localChanges: Land military units, Diplomats, Caravans and ships can now be ordered to Explore (press E, or pick it from the unit's menu). They head into the unknown by themselves each turn and come back to you when there's nowhere left they can reach or another civilization's unit comes near (closes #198).

Settlers can now be set to Automate (press A). They build roads, irrigation and mines around your cities by themselves, one job after another, until there's nothing left worth doing or an enemy comes near. Selecting them stops it (closes #200).

log: `Automate` gives the worker the `Automated` busy rule, records the order in a `StrategyNote` (player, job, path as tiles) and runs the game's `TerrainWork` strategy (`base-strategy-terrain-work`, found in `game.strategies`) with the moves the worker has left. Once a job is under way the worker carries the job's own busy rule, and the note records its name and the job's `PendingEffect`, so the `TurnStart` rule (`Low` priority, each worker in its own try/catch) can tell a job still under way from one that finished (effect discharged) or one the player called off (busy cleared, or a different busy rule or newer effect: re-ordering a busy worker leaves the old effect owed). The worker is handed back when there is no job, another player's unit is near, or no strategy is registered. The busy factory is registered so saves load, and after a load the worker takes up the noted job and path. See civ-clone/web-renderer#200.

`Explore` gives the unit the `Exploring` busy rule, records the order in a `StrategyNote` (player and target tile, never a `Path`) and runs the game's `Explore` strategy (`base-strategy-explore`, found in `game.strategies`) with the moves the unit has left. A `TurnStart` rule at `Low` priority carries the order on each turn, each unit in its own try/catch. The unit is handed back (not busy, active, moves kept, note dropped) when the strategy's `order()` returns false, another player's unit is near, or no strategy is registered; giving it other orders ends the order. The busy factory is registered so saves load, and after a load the unit heads on for the noted target. See civ-clone/web-renderer#198.
